answer_1.quote: Automatic meeting transcription and summarization (AMTS) systems ... AMS summarizes key insights in the transcribed text into well-structured and concise sentences. ... We evaluate the performance of various open-source LLMs ... to generate brief and detailed meeting summaries.
answer_1.outputs: Brief and detailed textual summaries of meetings

answer_2.quote: For recognition performance, CER serves as metric ... Regarding summarization performance, we utilize F-scores of the ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L (denoted as R-1, R-2, and R-L) as metrics.
